notes: Pipeline version 4, judge prompt version 3. Judge opencode-go/hy4-preview answered with low confidence and agreed with the deterministic outcome: no routing change is supported in any stage. Four judge rounds found and closed four defects: a published release claimed by two providers resolved to only one route; equal scores split into different ranks on the route name; the judge prompt omitted rank, alias scope, snapshot age, and the tie method; and the report could not say why a capability was uncovered. Two open items remain: contested_tolerance applies inside a unit, not to the gap between routes, so a small route gap still reads as an ordering; and published confidence intervals are recorded but not used to judge route separation when they overlap. Judge confidence varied between runs (low, high, low, low) on near-identical evidence, so treat that field as advisory only.
